responsibility: Declares the StdIO abstraction for generic character input and output plus stack-based redirection of the active read and write procedures. It defines the callback record types and push/pop/query operations that higher-level runtime code uses to virtualize standard character streams above the concrete IO module.
same_name_distinction: This header differs from GStdIO.cc by defining the public callback types and redirection API only; it does not contain the actual stack storage, default IO binding, or runtime push/pop/read/write dispatch code implemented in the .cc file.
